captions.detailed: An air-sprung dropper seatpost featuring a matte black finish on its main structural components. The assembly consists of a smooth, thick lower outer sleeve with a protruding brass-colored Schrader valve boss on its side, and a narrower pressurized inner post that telescopes vertically. At the top of the inner post sits a specialized two-bolt collar saddle clamp with silver-colored mounting bolts.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of an air-sprung dropper seatpost with a smooth lower outer sleeve, a side-mounted Schrader valve boss, and a telescoping inner post topped with a two-bolt collar saddle clamp using CadQuery.
captions.factory: Construct the outer sleeve using a main cylinder joined with a wider collar cylinder at the top, and attach a small side cylinder representing the Schrader valve boss. Model the inner post as a narrower cylinder concentric to the outer sleeve. Build the saddle clamp assembly at the top of the inner post using combined box primitives for the clamping brackets and small vertical cylinders for the dual fastening bolts.
